FeatureType.Name: zartographer:prod_client_boundary
FeatureType.Title: Client boundaries (full polygons + picker attributes)
FeatureType.Abstract: Client boundary polygons with synthesized client_pk and display name, over the writer-owned client_reference.client_boundary on Cloud SQL. Consumed by the Zartographer config-app: client picker (client_id,name list) and per-client boundary fetch. Attributes: client_pk, client_id, name.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:client_regions
FeatureType.Title: Client regions
FeatureType.Abstract: Per-client region polygons (Appleton, Downtown Neenah, etc. for Fox_Cities; analogous shapes for other clients). Filtered server-side by the validated client_id claim from the ADR-006 HMAC token.

FeatureType.Name: regions_app:client_ids
FeatureType.Title: Client roster (client picker)
FeatureType.Abstract: Distinct client_id roster for the zartico-gis-ticketing-service client picker (app/routers/clients.py: regions_app:client_ids, propertyName=client_id). Sourced from geoserver_views.client_ids, a live view of DISTINCT client_id over geoserver_views.client_boundary on Cloud SQL (zartographer-prod) — the canonical 231-client roster. Replaces the legacy ZG regions_app.client_ids view.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:client_boundary
FeatureType.Title: Client territory boundary
FeatureType.Abstract: Per-client territory polygon. The `client_id` SQL parameter is server-enforced via the ADR-006 HMAC servlet filter — callers cannot override which client they see. Public anonymous access returns no rows.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:prod_client_boundary_outline
FeatureType.Title: Client territory boundary outline
FeatureType.Abstract: Client territory boundaries rendered as lines (MultiLineString), consumed by the Zartographer config-app map (WMTS MVT tiles, boundaryOutline) and the zartico-gis-ticketing-service editing map (caller CQL by client_id). Sourced from geoserver_views.prod_client_boundary_outline, a live view that takes ST_Boundary over the writer-owned client_boundary. Line-only counterpart to zartographer:prod_client_boundary (full polygons). Attributes: client_pk, client_id, name.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:prod_poi_collapsed_alternatives
FeatureType.Title: Collapsed POI alternatives (alternate names/NAICS)
FeatureType.Abstract: Alternate-name/NAICS candidates decomposed from gis_master's compound `name` (* separator) and `naics_code` (space separator) fields, where the alternative differs substantially (pg_trgm similarity < 0.5) from the canonical f_name. Used by the Zartographer config-app's POI alternatives endpoint (pois/{poi_id}/alternatives). Attribute-only (dummy point geom). Refreshed by client_reference.refresh_v_client_mapping_snapshot(). Attributes: poi_id, alt_name, alt_naics_code, client_id.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:prod_poi_in_product_centroid
FeatureType.Title: In-product POIs (centroid, parent+child)
FeatureType.Abstract: Single point layer combining prod_poi_in_product_parent and _child with a `role` discriminator ('parent'/'child'), for the Zartographer config-app POI list/map (zartico-configuration-app-service app/routers/pois.py). Replaces two separate polygon fetches (43MB+ responses for large clients). Attributes: id, f_name, f_poi_type, naics_code, client_id, address, city, state, include_children (parent rows), parents (child rows), role.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:prod_poi_in_product_child
FeatureType.Title: In-product POIs (child)
FeatureType.Abstract: Product-scoped POIs WITH parents (children rolled up under a parent). Joined from client_reference.v_client_mapping_snapshot + public_reference.gis_master on Cloud SQL (zartographer-prod), WHERE parents IS NOT NULL AND parents <> ''. Refreshed by codecs_geo's refresh_v_client_mapping_snapshot() (REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY). Consumed by the zartico-gis-ticketing-service editing map: POI search (id,f_name,naics_code, client_id) and the /geometry endpoint (polygon). Attributes: id, f_name, f_poi_type, naics_code, client_id, parents, address, city, state.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:prod_poi_in_product_parent
FeatureType.Title: In-product POIs (parent)
FeatureType.Abstract: Product-scoped POIs with no parent (the canonical record). Joined from client_reference.v_client_mapping_snapshot + public_reference.gis_master on Cloud SQL (zartographer-prod), WHERE parents IS NULL OR parents = ''. Refreshed by codecs_geo's refresh_v_client_mapping_snapshot() (REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY). Consumed by the zartico-gis-ticketing-service editing map: POI search (id,f_name,naics_code, client_id) and the /geometry endpoint (polygon). Attributes: id, f_name, f_poi_type, naics_code, client_id, address, city, state, include_children.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:prod_poi_not_in_product
FeatureType.Title: POIs not in product (per client)
FeatureType.Abstract: POIs whose geometry intersects a client's boundary but are NOT mapped to that client in v_client_mapping_snapshot — the per-client "missing POIs" surface used by the Zartographer config-app (pois/not-in-product) and the config-app-web notInProduct tile layer. Joined from public_reference.gis_master x client_reference.client_boundary on Cloud SQL, refreshed by client_reference.refresh_v_client_mapping_snapshot(). Attributes: id, f_name, f_poi_type, naics_code, client_id. NOTE: lacks address/city/state (legacy parity — config-app pois.py has a matching TODO).

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:client_boundary_preview
FeatureType.Title: Proposed client boundary (onboarding preview)
FeatureType.Abstract:
Transient per-ticket PROPOSED boundary polygon for the codecs_geo onboarding writer's human-in-the-loop review. During the Jira "To Do" phase the writer resolves + dissolves the proposed boundary, UPSERTs one row here keyed on an opaque preview_token, and renders a map for the ticket; on approval (ticket → In Progress) it writes the real client_boundary and DELETEs this row.
Reviewers see the proposed polygon over county/state reference lines — the map image is composited at GetMap time from `zartographer:county_boundaries,zartographer:state_boundaries,zartographer:client_boundary_preview` (there is no catalog layer group; the writer lists the layers in one WMS GetMap request).
NOT a confirmed client and NOT refreshed — see db/geoserver_views/client_boundary_preview.sql.

FeatureType.Name: regions_app:primary_pois
FeatureType.Title: Regions app — POI points
FeatureType.Abstract: POI points for the regions app (regions-service poi_service): gid, f_name, name. Sourced from geoserver_views.regions_app_primary_pois, a live index-backed view over public_reference.gis_master (ST_PointOnSurface, served via gis_master_pos_gix). Replaces the legacy ZG regions_app:primary_pois matview.

FeatureType.Name: regions_app:client_boundaries
FeatureType.Title: Regions app — client boundary
FeatureType.Abstract: Per-client territory polygon + precomputed bbox_4326_wms, for the regions app (regions-service boundary_service / poi_service). client_id is server-enforced via the ADR-006 HMAC filter. Sourced from geoserver_views.regions_app_client_boundaries over client_reference.client_boundary.

FeatureType.Name: regions_app:client_regions
FeatureType.Title: Regions app — client regions
FeatureType.Abstract: Per-client regions (name as `region`, comma-joined tract fips as `region_fips`, is_custom, geom) for the regions app (regions-service region_service). Sourced from geoserver_views.regions_app_client_regions over client_reference.effective_regions — flag-gated so custom-region clients get custom rows, not stale standard ones. client_id is server-enforced via the ADR-006 HMAC filter.

FeatureType.Name: regions_app:census_tracts
FeatureType.Title: Regions app — per-client census tracts
FeatureType.Abstract: Per-client census-tract membership + geometry for the regions app (regions-service census_tract_service): client_id, tract_fips, meets_50pct. Sourced from geoserver_views.regions_app_census_tracts (client_boundary membership array joined to public_reference.census_tracts_water geometry, 4269->4326). Replaces the legacy ZG regions_app:census_tracts.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:synthetic_cities
FeatureType.Title: Synthetic cities (canonical reference)
FeatureType.Abstract: Canonical "city-like" polygons (~22.7k features) used as a building block for client visualizations. Public layer — the polygons themselves are not client-scoped. SUP-1802's "13 synthetic cities for Fox Cities" is assembled downstream by intersecting these with the client boundary.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:Census_Designated_Place
FeatureType.Title: TIGER census designated places
FeatureType.Abstract: TIGER/Line Census Designated Places (~12,454 features) — unincorporated "place-like" settlements. Raw reference geography toggled on in the Zartographer Synthetic-Cities viewer (ZTPG-7) alongside incorporated places. Sourced from geoserver_views.census_designated_place on this Cloud SQL instance.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:County_Subdivision
FeatureType.Title: TIGER county subdivisions
FeatureType.Abstract: TIGER/Line county subdivisions (~36,639 features) — minor civil divisions / census county divisions. Raw reference geography toggled on in the Zartographer Synthetic-Cities viewer (ZTPG-7) to show the county-subdivision building blocks behind a synthetic city. Sourced from geoserver_views.county_subdivision on this Cloud SQL instance.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:Incorporated_Place
FeatureType.Title: TIGER incorporated places
FeatureType.Abstract: TIGER/Line incorporated places (~19,734 features). Raw reference geography toggled on in the Zartographer Synthetic-Cities viewer (ZTPG-7) so CSMs can see the incorporated municipalities a synthetic city was assembled from. Sourced from geoserver_views.incorporated_place on this Cloud SQL instance.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:census_tract_boundaries
FeatureType.Title: U.S. census tract boundaries (legacy alias)
FeatureType.Abstract: Census tract polygon boundaries (TIGER/Line 2020), ~85,187 features. Legacy layer name preserved from the test-geoserver catalog for migration compatibility — this layer shares its backing matview with zartographer:census_tracts (geoserver_views.census_tracts). Both names serve identical data; new consumers should prefer the shorter zartographer:census_tracts name.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:census_tracts
FeatureType.Title: U.S. census tracts (TIGER/Line 2020)
FeatureType.Abstract: Census tract polygon boundaries (TIGER/Line 2020), ~85,187 features. Sourced from geoserver_views.census_tracts, a materialized view over the local public_reference.census_tracts table on Cloud SQL. Each row carries the 11-char tract_fips plus derived state_fips (2 chars) and county_fips (5 chars) — county_fips joins to zartographer:county_boundaries on its county_fips PK.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:county_progress
FeatureType.Title: U.S. counties with population + area stats
FeatureType.Abstract:
3,143 US counties (no territories) with TIGER-derived geometry and DE-curated population, pop_per_sqmi, and area_sqmi columns. Sourced from geoserver_views.county_progress, a materialized view over the local public_reference.county_boundaries table on Cloud SQL.
Distinct from zartographer:county_boundaries — that layer serves the 3,237-row raw TIGER catalog (includes territories, no population/area columns) and is the right pick when you need the canonical county outline. This layer is the right pick for choropleth maps and population-aware analytics.
Layer name preserved from the legacy test-geoserver catalog for migration compatibility (consumers that hit zartographer:county_progress keep working without a client-side change).

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:county_boundaries
FeatureType.Title: U.S. county boundaries
FeatureType.Abstract: County polygon boundaries (TIGER/Line + Zartico processing metadata). Sourced from geoserver_views.county_boundaries, a materialized view over the local public_reference.county_boundaries_raw table on Cloud SQL. 3,237 features.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:state_boundaries
FeatureType.Title: U.S. state boundaries
FeatureType.Abstract: State + territory polygon boundaries (TIGER/Line). Sourced from geoserver_views.state_boundaries, a materialized view over the local public_reference.state_boundaries table on Cloud SQL. 56 features (50 states + DC + 5 territories).

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:zcta_boundaries
FeatureType.Title: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (TIGER)
FeatureType.Abstract: Census ZIP Code Tabulation Area polygon boundaries (TIGER), ~33,791 features. A ZCTA is the Census Bureau's approximation of a USPS ZIP code's coverage area; ZCTAs differ from operational ZIP codes in some cases (PO-box-only ZIPs have no ZCTA, edge cases differ at the boundary) but are the standard public-domain geometry for ZIP-level analysis. Sourced from geoserver_views.zcta_boundaries, a materialized view over the local public_reference.zcta_boundaries table on Cloud SQL.

FeatureType.Name: zartographer:zip_synthetic_city_assignment
FeatureType.Title: ZIP → synthetic city spend assignment
FeatureType.Abstract: One feature per spend ZIP, carrying the synthetic city that ZIP's Z5 spend is bucketed into. Zartico spend is attributed by synthetic city (GoodData "Destination City" = synthetic_cities.city_id), never by ZIP: a merchant ZIP maps to a synthetic city through its population-weighted- centroid census tract (ZIP → spend_reference.zip_geo_ref.census_tract_fips → public_reference.synthetic_city_tracts.city_id). When that tract belongs to a synthetic city the client doesn't think of as "their" city, the ZIP's spend lands in the "wrong" bucket and vanishes from the city they filter to. Built for SUP-1812 (Mat-Su / Palmer ZIP 99645 → synthetic city "Gateway, AK"). Geometry is the ZCTA polygon; ~7k point/PO-box ZIPs have no ZCTA (has_polygon = false) and don't draw. Sourced from geoserver_views.zip_synthetic_city_assignment.
